column5: PROMOTED. Both open divergences are closed, one by a fix and one by re-measuring at equal depth. BODY SPACING, fixed: the body is 738x320 at padding 16 and holds TWO children - a 706x238 block (filter row 706x34, then the 706x188 rows at gap 16) ending at y=254, and a 706x18 Export/View all footer starting at y=286. So the frame puts 32 between the list and the footer while the column shipped one flat 16 for both. Now a 16 column gap plus a 16 top margin on the footer from 1024 up, which resolves 16 at 375/768/1023 and 32 at 1024/1440 - the two narrower bodies hold ONE child each (319x320 and 684x322), so their itemSpacing never paints and 16 is right there. FOOTER TYPE AND FILL, fixed: the labels are Manrope Regular 14/18 at -0.56px in #95A09F and shipped as Mulish 12/16 with no tracking; the two shortcut chips are FILLED #001615 at padding 6,2 radius 4 with Mulish Regular 11/14 at -0.44px white, and shipped as a #123F3C-stroked chip with no fill and no line height paired to its 11px. The 20 between the pairs and the 8 inside each were already right. UNDERLINE, no longer a divergence and the earlier reading was a depth error: it compared a vector in the band's own space against a tab inside a strip inset 16 from it. At equal depth the 343 and 708 bands both put a 39-wide rule at x=274 under a 39-wide tab at x=274 - exact, which is what an inset-x-0 underline draws. Only the 738 band disagrees: a 54-wide rule at x=305 under a 45-wide tab spanning 310..355, so it starts 5 early, runs 4 long, and centres on the tab to within half a pixel. One tier out of three on a free-floating absolute vector is a frame defect, not a spec. ROWS re-read and correct at this tier: spans 6 apart, Mulish Regular 14/18 at -0.56px on every one, handle #56C7F3, the action word and 'at' and the price #FFFFFF, the down side #FF574A and the up side #17F9B4, age slot 77 wide at Mulish 12/16 -0.48px #95A09F. Band 738x44 radius 16/16/0/0 fill #122524 padding 4,16,0,16 with a 1px #123F3C rule along the bottom only. THREE ABSENCES STAND and all three are source problems: the 18x18 avatar (a counterparty is an address with no profile), the trailing 16x16 action glyph (no action is defined for a settled fill), and the 'for <date>' clause, whose date is the market's target date and not something a fill carries.

DEMOTED from done, on a row shape nobody had measured. The trade row is authored TWICE, not three times: 375 and 768 draw the same node field for field and 1440 draws a different one. At this tier the row is 32 tall on a 48 pitch with the divider 8 below at y=40, and it is a 32x32 avatar, then 8, then a 179-wide TWO-LINE stack at gap 4 - line one 148 wide (handle 66, then the action clause at x=70), line two at y=18 and 179 wide ('for' 15, date 81 at x=19, 'at' 11 at x=104, price 60 at x=119) - with a right cluster 79 wide holding a 57-wide age and a 16x16 glyph at gap 6. Every span is Mulish Regular 12/14 at -0.48px; 1440 is Mulish Regular 14/18 at -0.56px with spans 6 apart on one line. FIXED THIS LANE: the type now steps 12/14 through 767 and 14/18 from 1024 as a pair, the span gap steps 4 to 6 at the same cut, and the age keeps 12px with its box stepping 14 to 16 and its fixed 77 slot arriving only at 1440 - every board was drawing the 1440 pair, 2px oversized and 4px over-led. The FILTER TRIGGER above the list is fixed too: it is one node on three boards whose gap steps 12/10/8 and whose line box steps 16/18/18, giving 32 tall here and 34 from 768, against a flat gap 8, a flat 18 box and a fixed 34 height; its label is Manrope 14 at -0.04em, not Mulish, and its radius is 8 by value where the token name resolves to 12 in this preset. STILL PARTIAL for the two-line stack itself: our row is one wrapping line, and splitting it needs a ruling because the frame's second line is mostly the 'for <date>' clause a fill cannot carry - see the lane report. The 32x32 avatar and the 16x16 action glyph stay absent for the same source reasons as the wide tier. Band 343x40 radius 12/12/0/0 fill #122524 padding 4,12,0,12; body 343x352 radius 0/0/12/12 padding 12,12,20,12 holding one 319x320 child; header row 319x32 with the two triggers 75 and 132 wide at gap 8 and a 48x18 badge slot right; rows block 319x272.

Second 343-wide copy, and it is the same node as the other one: 343x392, band 343x40 radius 12/12/0/0 padding 4,12,0,12 with a 1px #123F3C rule on the bottom, body 343x352 radius 0/0/12/12 padding 12,12,20,12 with the same 1px rule on the top, both #122524. Carries the same demotion and the same evidence: the row here is the 32-tall two-line variant at Mulish 12/14, not the one-line 14/18 the column shipped everywhere.
